integrations.skill-installation.meaning: Install only the Human2AI skill in the current project for the user's chosen Agent; the Human2AI application is already installed.
integrations.skill-installation.scope: Home page command switch below the product introduction and above creation cards. A short installation title sits to the left of Agent and CLI tabs; Agent instructions are selected initially.
integrations.skill-installation.referent: The human2ai skill in yisi-ai/human2ai, installed using the generic skills CLI with project scope and no agent-specific flag.
integrations.skill-installation.precedence: This installs a skill only, not the Human2AI application or a session connection. It does not restrict the user to Codex or choose a global installation.
examples: Ask the current Agent to install the human2ai skill for this project.
Run npx skills add yisi-ai/human2ai --skill human2ai from the target project.
nonExamples: Connect to a saved composition session.

integrations.installation-copy.meaning: Copy the currently displayed skill installation instructions or commands to the clipboard.
integrations.installation-copy.scope: Home page skill installation guidance only.
integrations.installation-copy.referent: The selected Agent instruction or CLI command block.
integrations.installation-copy.precedence: Not a session connection command or an image-generation prompt; success reuses clipboard.copied.

integrations.composition-example.meaning: An example user request to recover the composition of a supplied reference image as an editable canvas.
integrations.composition-example.referent: The existing reference-projection workflow for composition sessions.
integrations.composition-example.precedence: Communicates user intent without prescribing literal outlines or promising pixel-identical reconstruction.
examples: Ask to put a reference image's composition onto an editable canvas.

integrations.ui-sketch-example.meaning: An example user request to edit an existing UI sketch according to its notes and export a preview.
integrations.ui-sketch-example.referent: The existing UI-layout capture editing and preview-export workflow.
integrations.ui-sketch-example.precedence: Refers to the editable sketch; does not promise production code or changes to a deployed application.
examples: Ask the Agent to adjust a sketch using the user's notes.

integrations.spatial-example.meaning: An example user request to create a 3D space, pose a character, and export the camera view.
integrations.spatial-example.referent: The existing spatial session, character posing, and camera rendering capabilities.
integrations.spatial-example.precedence: The exported view represents the authored scene; it is not a promise to generate a photorealistic image or animation.
examples: Ask the Agent to pose a character and export a camera view.
nonExamples: Modify a composition without a spatial session.

home.skillInstallation.title.role: short heading beside the method tabs and accessible name for the installation command section

home.skillInstallation.agentTab.duplicateReason: Agent here names the installation method; sessionDetails.agent names a session connection field and canvas metadata uses it for node provenance.

home.skillInstallation.agentPrompt.role: copyable installation request for an external Agent

home.skillInstallation.copy.role: accessible name and hover title for the icon-only button beside the visible installation content

home.skillInstallation.copyFailed.role: clipboard failure feedback with manual-copy fallback
